meta.title: Ambush
meta.description: Like a spider, it quietly waits for its prey to enter its web.

units.rawText: 4:11 am, one day ago.
units.displayText: 4:11 am, one day ago.

spans.text: 4:11 am, one day ago.

units.rawText: In the Oasis' Command Center.
units.displayText: In the Oasis' Command Center.

spans.text: In the Oasis' Command Center.

units.rawText: Professor, the frontline has stabilized for now.
units.displayText: Professor, the frontline has stabilized for now.

spans.text: Professor, the frontline has stabilized for now.

units.rawText: But the Sandbox Barrier can't stop these monsters, and we're barely hanging on through sheer force alone. If a new wave of attack comes...
units.displayText: But the Sandbox Barrier can't stop these monsters, and we're barely hanging on through sheer force alone. If a new wave of attack comes...

spans.text: But the Sandbox Barrier can't stop these monsters, and we're barely hanging on through sheer force alone. If a new wave of attack comes...

units.rawText: ...How are things on Antonina's end?
units.displayText: ...How are things on Antonina's end?

spans.text: ...How are things on Antonina's end?

units.rawText: Thanks to the live sample Croque brought back, Antonina managed to create a code patch that can stabilize a neural cloud firewall.
units.displayText: Thanks to the live sample Croque brought back, Antonina managed to create a code patch that can stabilize a neural cloud firewall.

spans.text: Thanks to the live sample Croque brought back, Antonina managed to create a code patch that can stabilize a neural cloud firewall.

units.rawText: But...
units.displayText: But...

spans.text: But...

units.rawText: Let me tell the Professor.
units.displayText: Let me tell the Professor.

spans.text: Let me tell the Professor.

units.rawText: Antonina? How are the infected doing?
units.displayText: Antonina? How are the infected doing?

spans.text: Antonina? How are the infected doing?

units.rawText: After injecting the code obtained from analyzing the live sample, we've stabilized them for the time being—
units.displayText: After injecting the code obtained from analyzing the live sample, we've stabilized them for the time being—

spans.text: After injecting the code obtained from analyzing the live sample, we've stabilized them for the time being—

units.rawText: —But only for the time being.
units.displayText: —But only for the time being.

spans.text: —But only for the time being.

units.rawText: You can't stop the virus?
units.displayText: You can't stop the virus?

spans.text: You can't stop the virus?

units.rawText: These monsters exist in a very strange state. They're extremely unstable and chaotic.
units.displayText: These monsters exist in a very strange state. They're extremely unstable and chaotic.

spans.text: These monsters exist in a very strange state. They're extremely unstable and chaotic.

units.rawText: In biological terms, these monsters are progeny. They were spawned from a certain mother entity and the virus that they carry was a later evolution.
units.displayText: In biological terms, these monsters are progeny. They were spawned from a certain mother entity and the virus that they carry was a later evolution.

spans.text: In biological terms, these monsters are progeny. They were spawned from a certain mother entity and the virus that they carry was a later evolution.

units.rawText: Because of that, all we can do at this stage is temporarily suppress the infection. We need to find the mother entity.
units.displayText: Because of that, all we can do at this stage is temporarily suppress the infection. We need to find the mother entity.

spans.text: Because of that, all we can do at this stage is temporarily suppress the infection. We need to find the mother entity.

units.rawText: Then, Croque...
units.displayText: Then, Croque...

spans.text: Then, Croque...

units.rawText: ...Croque is now in the second stage of infection. Her mind has sunk into her Tertiary Layer.
units.displayText: ...Croque is now in the second stage of infection. Her mind has sunk into her Tertiary Layer.

spans.text: ...Croque is now in the second stage of infection. Her mind has sunk into her Tertiary Layer.

units.rawText: The code we obtained has managed to halt the virus' erosion of the Tertiary Layer. At the very least, we can guarantee that her basic operations and core data will not be affected.
units.displayText: The code we obtained has managed to halt the virus' erosion of the Tertiary Layer. At the very least, we can guarantee that her basic operations and core data will not be affected.

spans.text: The code we obtained has managed to halt the virus' erosion of the Tertiary Layer. At the very least, we can guarantee that her basic operations and core data will not be affected.

units.rawText: Just then, Antonina's monitor lights up with a call request.
units.displayText: Just then, Antonina's monitor lights up with a call request.

spans.text: Just then, Antonina's monitor lights up with a call request.

units.rawText: >Call request received, now connecting...
units.displayText: Call request received, now connecting...

spans.text: Call request received, now connecting...

units.rawText: The analysis results are out. We found some program fragments that were not entirely distorted in the monster, and they all point to the Pierides Sector.
units.displayText: The analysis results are out. We found some program fragments that were not entirely distorted in the monster, and they all point to the Pierides Sector.

spans.text: The analysis results are out. We found some program fragments that were not entirely distorted in the monster, and they all point to the
Pierides Sector

units.rawText: Pierides... As I recall, that's the closest sector to us, and it's very small.
units.displayText: Pierides... As I recall, that's the closest sector to us, and it's very small.

spans.text: Pierides... As I recall, that's the closest sector to us, and it's very small.

units.rawText: Yes. According to the results of the previous survey mission, it's an "art sector". I believe the monsters that attacked us originated in there.
units.displayText: Yes. According to the results of the previous survey mission, it's an "art sector". I believe the monsters that attacked us originated in there.

spans.text: Yes. According to the results of the previous survey mission, it's an "art sector". I believe the monsters that attacked us originated in there.

units.rawText: Persicaria, put a team together and prepare to move out.
units.displayText: Persicaria, put a team together and prepare to move out.

spans.text: Persicaria, put a team together and prepare to move out.

units.rawText: Understood...
units.displayText: Understood...

spans.text: Understood...

units.rawText: Before Persicaria can finish, Antonina cuts in.
units.displayText: Before Persicaria can finish, Antonina cuts in.

spans.text: Before Persicaria can finish, Antonina cuts in.

units.rawText: Professor, that is not a good idea.
units.displayText: Professor, that is not a good idea.

spans.text: Professor, that is not a good idea.

units.rawText: Considering the Oasis has been reduced to this state even with our defensive strength, it is very likely that Pierides has completely fallen by now.
units.displayText: Considering the Oasis has been reduced to this state even with our defensive strength, it is very likely that Pierides has completely fallen by now.

spans.text: Considering the Oasis has been reduced to this state even with our defensive strength, it is very likely that Pierides has completely fallen by now.

units.rawText: Going into a fully infected sector like that is suicide.
units.displayText: Going into a fully infected sector like that is suicide.

spans.text: Going into a fully infected sector like that is suicide.

units.rawText: Still, regardless of the risk, if we can find the monsters' mother and obtain its source code, Croque and the others can be saved.
units.displayText: Still, regardless of the risk, if we can find the monsters' mother and obtain its source code, Croque and the others can be saved.

spans.text: Still, regardless of the risk, if we can find the monsters' mother and obtain its source code, Croque and the others can be saved.

units.rawText: We have no other choice.
units.displayText: We have no other choice.

spans.text: We have no other choice.

units.rawText: No, there is another choice. We have simply refused to consider it.
units.displayText: No, there is another choice. We have simply refused to consider it.

spans.text: No, there is another choice. We have simply refused to consider it.

units.rawText: Persicaria, reset them now before things get worse. Otherwise we'll lose even the chance to do that.
units.displayText: Persicaria, reset them now before things get worse. Otherwise we'll lose even the chance to do that.

spans.text: Persicaria, reset them now before things get worse. Otherwise we'll lose even the chance to do that.

units.rawText: You know that's the same as killing them!
units.displayText: You know that's the same as killing them!

spans.text: You know that's the same as killing them!

units.rawText: Of COURSE I do!!
units.displayText: Of COURSE I do!!

spans.text: Of COURSE I do!!

units.rawText: But that is still preferable to not seeing them ever again...
units.displayText: But that is still preferable to not seeing them ever again...

spans.text: But that is still preferable to not seeing them ever again...

units.rawText: If only there were a better way... Dammit!
units.displayText: If only there were a better way... Dammit!

spans.text: If only there were a better way... Dammit!

units.rawText: Antonina pounds her fist on the table.
units.displayText: Antonina pounds her fist on the table.

spans.text: Antonina pounds her fist on the table.

options.rawText: You do have a point, I'll give you that.
options.displayText: You do have a point, I'll give you that.

spans.text: You do have a point, I'll give you that.

options.rawText: It's not like you to give up without a fight.
options.displayText: It's not like you to give up without a fight.

spans.text: It's not like you to give up without a fight.

units.rawText: However, this is no reason for us to back down. If these monsters continue attacking the Oasis, how many more times will we have to reset our friends?
units.displayText: However, this is no reason for us to back down. If these monsters continue attacking the Oasis, how many more times will we have to reset our friends?

spans.text: However, this is no reason for us to back down. If these monsters continue attacking the Oasis, how many more times will we have to reset our friends?

units.rawText: I understand your concerns, but leaving the price of doing so aside, given the present circumstances, how many times are you prepared to reset them?
units.displayText: I understand your concerns, but leaving the price of doing so aside, given the present circumstances, how many times are you prepared to reset them?

spans.text: I understand your concerns, but leaving the price of doing so aside, given the present circumstances, how many times are you prepared to reset them?

units.rawText: Antonina, this isn't just for Croque, but for everyone who has been infected.
units.displayText: Antonina, this isn't just for Croque, but for everyone who has been infected.

spans.text: Antonina, this isn't just for Croque, but for everyone who has been infected.

units.rawText: Those monsters are still pressing the attack. Our main force is holding them off, but we don't know when their next wave will arrive.
units.displayText: Those monsters are still pressing the attack. Our main force is holding them off, but we don't know when their next wave will arrive.

spans.text: Those monsters are still pressing the attack. Our main force is holding them off, but we don't know when their next wave will arrive.

units.rawText: We aren't just going to the Pierides Sector to find the source code, but also to deal with the problem at its root.
units.displayText: We aren't just going to the Pierides Sector to find the source code, but also to deal with the problem at its root.

spans.text: We aren't just going to the Pierides Sector to find the source code, but also to deal with the problem at its root.

units.rawText: ...I understand. I'll go along with your plans, Professor.
units.displayText: ...I understand. I'll go along with your plans, Professor.

spans.text: ...I understand. I'll go along with your plans, Professor.

units.rawText: We'll leave the main portion of our armed forces behind to hold off the monster attacks. Persicaria, Antonina, Sol, gather our people into a strike team and prepare to head out.
units.displayText: We'll leave the main portion of our armed forces behind to hold off the monster attacks. Persicaria, Antonina, Sol, gather our people into a strike team and prepare to head out.

spans.text: We'll leave the main portion of our armed forces behind to hold off the monster attacks. Persicaria, Antonina, Sol, gather our people into a strike team and prepare to head out.

units.rawText: Roger!
units.displayText: Roger!

spans.text: Roger!

units.rawText: Outside the Pierides Sector.
units.displayText: Outside the Pierides Sector.

spans.text: Outside the Pierides Sector.

units.rawText:
Antonina sets up a ring of strange devices around us.
Once these devices start functioning, she begins connecting to Pierides' firewall.
units.displayText:
Antonina sets up a ring of strange devices around us.
Once these devices start functioning, she begins connecting to Pierides' firewall.

spans.text:
Antonina sets up a ring of strange devices around us.
Once these devices start functioning, she begins connecting to Pierides' firewall.

units.rawText: What are these things? Why do they look so old and beat-up...
units.displayText: What are these things? Why do they look so old and beat-up...

spans.text: What are these things? Why do they look so old and beat-up...

units.rawText: Don't touch them, they're protective devices that Antonina rigged up at the last minute. They'll keep us safe, to a certain extent.
units.displayText: Don't touch them, they're protective devices that Antonina rigged up at the last minute. They'll keep us safe, to a certain extent.

spans.text: Don't touch them, they're protective devices that Antonina rigged up at the last minute. They'll keep us safe, to a certain extent.

units.rawText: Er... I was just asking. You guys look way too tense.
units.displayText: Er... I was just asking. You guys look way too tense.

spans.text: Er... I was just asking. You guys look way too tense.

units.rawText: ...You're right. Maybe we ought to be more positive.
units.displayText: ...You're right. Maybe we ought to be more positive.

spans.text: ...You're right. Maybe we ought to be more positive.

units.rawText: Antonina, how's the firewall going?
units.displayText: Antonina, how's the firewall going?

spans.text: Antonina, how's the firewall going?

units.rawText: Antonina?
units.displayText: Antonina?

spans.text: Antonina?

units.rawText: Persicaria lightly taps Antonina, who has not responded to her query.
units.displayText: Persicaria lightly taps Antonina, who has not responded to her query.

spans.text: Persicaria lightly taps Antonina, who has not responded to her query.

units.rawText: Thud.
units.displayText: Thud.

spans.text: Thud.

units.rawText: <size=40>Antonina!?</size>
units.displayText: Antonina!?

spans.text: Antonina!?

units.rawText: Antonina collapses to the ground and curls up into a ball, her face contorted in pain.
units.displayText: Antonina collapses to the ground and curls up into a ball, her face contorted in pain.

spans.text: Antonina collapses to the ground and curls up into a ball, her face contorted in pain.

units.rawText: Oh no, her neural cloud's been infected!
units.displayText: Oh no, her neural cloud's been infected!

spans.text: Oh no, her neural cloud's been infected!

units.rawText: Was it the firewall!?
units.displayText: Was it the firewall!?

spans.text: Was it the firewall!?

units.rawText: Before I can help Antonina up, Sol's cry and the scene before my eyes transfix me to the spot.
units.displayText: Before I can help Antonina up, Sol's cry and the scene before my eyes transfix me to the spot.

spans.text: Before I can help Antonina up, Sol's cry and the scene before my eyes transfix me to the spot.

units.rawText: A wave of what looks like a malfunctioning light effect flashes past, and countless holes suddenly open up in Pierides' previously calm and intact firewall.
units.displayText: A wave of what looks like a malfunctioning light effect flashes past, and countless holes suddenly open up in Pierides' previously calm and intact firewall.

spans.text: A wave of what looks like a malfunctioning light effect flashes past, and countless holes suddenly open up in Pierides' previously calm and intact firewall.

units.rawText: Skreeeeee!
units.displayText: Skreeeeee!

spans.text: Skreeeeee!

units.rawText: Countless malformed programs emerge from the gaps and pour down on us like a tide.
units.displayText: Countless malformed programs emerge from the gaps and pour down on us like a tide.

spans.text: Countless malformed programs emerge from the gaps and pour down on us like a tide.

units.rawText: Kaka-ka-
units.displayText: Kaka-ka-

spans.text: Kaka-ka-

units.rawText: The barrier generated by the protective devices barely manages to hold the monsters at bay, and all we can do is cower within it.
units.displayText: The barrier generated by the protective devices barely manages to hold the monsters at bay, and all we can do is cower within it.

spans.text: The barrier generated by the protective devices barely manages to hold the monsters at bay, and all we can do is cower within it.

units.rawText: Anna! Wake up!
units.displayText: Anna! Wake up!

spans.text: Anna! Wake up!

units.rawText: No good, she's been infected! All we can do is take her and leave ASAP!
units.displayText: No good, she's been infected! All we can do is take her and leave ASAP!

spans.text: No good, she's been infected! All we can do is take her and leave ASAP!

units.rawText: Can we try to break through while carrying these devices with us?
units.displayText: Can we try to break through while carrying these devices with us?

spans.text: Can we try to break through while carrying these devices with us?

units.rawText: No! Moving the devices is risky!
units.displayText: No! Moving the devices is risky!

spans.text: No! Moving the devices is risky!

units.rawText: Uaaahhh-ka—
units.displayText: Uaaahhh-ka—

spans.text: Uaaahhh-ka—

units.rawText: Purplish-black body fluids leak underneath the barrier and start crawling up our legs.
units.displayText: Purplish-black body fluids leak underneath the barrier and start crawling up our legs.

spans.text: Purplish-black body fluids leak underneath the barrier and start crawling up our legs.

units.rawText: Even if it's risky, we have to-
units.displayText: Even if it's risky, we have to-

spans.text: Even if it's risky, we have to-

units.rawText: Before I can finish, the barrier crumples like a piece of paper under the weight of the monsters bearing down on it.
units.displayText: Before I can finish, the barrier crumples like a piece of paper under the weight of the monsters bearing down on it.

spans.text: Before I can finish, the barrier crumples like a piece of paper under the weight of the monsters bearing down on it.

units.rawText: The next second, a purple-black tide engulfs us.
units.displayText: The next second, a purple-black tide engulfs us.

spans.text: The next second, a purple-black tide engulfs us.

units.rawText: Look out!!
units.displayText: Look out!!

spans.text: Look out!!

units.rawText: Sol rushes before me like a loosed arrow and cleaves an incoming monster in two.
units.displayText: Sol rushes before me like a loosed arrow and cleaves an incoming monster in two.

spans.text: Sol rushes before me like a loosed arrow and cleaves an incoming monster in two.

units.rawText: However, the dead monster's body do not stop moving, and the ones behind continue pushing it toward us.
units.displayText: However, the dead monster's body do not stop moving, and the ones behind continue pushing it toward us.

spans.text: However, the dead monster's body do not stop moving, and the ones behind continue pushing it toward us.

units.rawText: Sol! Take the Professor and get out of here!
units.displayText: Sol! Take the Professor and get out of here!

spans.text: Sol! Take the Professor and get out of here!

units.rawText: What about you!?
units.displayText: What about you!?

spans.text: What about you!?

units.rawText: I'll use operands to form a barrier to hold them off!
units.displayText: I'll use operands to form a barrier to hold them off!

spans.text: I'll use operands to form a barrier to hold them off!

units.rawText: Operands gather in Persicaria's hands, briefly delaying the monsters.
units.displayText: Operands gather in Persicaria's hands, briefly delaying the monsters.

spans.text: Operands gather in Persicaria's hands, briefly delaying the monsters.

units.rawText: However, the purple-black fluids they secrete dissolve the barrier before it can fully form.
units.displayText: However, the purple-black fluids they secrete dissolve the barrier before it can fully form.

spans.text: However, the purple-black fluids they secrete dissolve the barrier before it can fully form.

units.rawText: Sol swiftly blocks the monsters ahead of us, but tentacles from the flanks extend towards me...
units.displayText: Sol swiftly blocks the monsters ahead of us, but tentacles from the flanks extend towards me...

spans.text: Sol swiftly blocks the monsters ahead of us, but tentacles from the flanks extend towards me...

units.rawText: PROFESSOR!!
units.displayText: PROFESSOR!!

spans.text: PROFESSOR!!

units.rawText: I feel myself being shoved away, then comes the sound of something being pierced though.
units.displayText: I feel myself being shoved away, then comes the sound of something being pierced though.

spans.text: I feel myself being shoved away, then comes the sound of something being pierced though.

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: Spraying operands mix with blackish-purple bodily fluids.
units.displayText: Spraying operands mix with blackish-purple bodily fluids.

spans.text: Spraying operands mix with blackish-purple bodily fluids.

units.rawText: By the time my vision returns, Persicaria has already collapsed onto the ground.
units.displayText: By the time my vision returns, Persicaria has already collapsed onto the ground.

spans.text: By the time my vision returns, Persicaria has already collapsed onto the ground.

units.rawText: PERSICARIA!!
units.displayText: PERSICARIA!!

spans.text: PERSICARIA!!

units.rawText: (Groans)
units.displayText: Groans

spans.text: Groans

units.rawText: Pierides... is already...
units.displayText: Pierides... is already...

spans.text: Pierides... is already...

units.rawText: Professor... run...
units.displayText: Professor... run...

spans.text: Professor... run...

units.rawText: Hehe, though it seems this movie's a little boring for you.
units.displayText: Hehe, though it seems this movie's a little boring for you.

spans.text: Hehe, though it seems this movie's a little boring for you.

units.rawText: You WILL overcome all the difficulties in your way, won't you, Commander?
units.displayText: You WILL overcome all the difficulties in your way, won't you, Commander?

spans.text: You WILL overcome all the difficulties in your way, won't you, Commander?

units.rawText: Ah, was that girl in white you just saw Antonina?
units.displayText: Ah, was that girl in white you just saw Antonina?

spans.text: Ah, was that girl in white you just saw Antonina?

units.rawText: I never said I saw a girl in white, did I?
units.displayText: I never said I saw a girl in white, did I?

spans.text: I never said I saw a girl in white, did I?

units.rawText: ...You should not be here.
units.displayText: ...You should not be here.

spans.text: ...You should not be here.

units.rawText: I return to the garden, still in a daze. The fragmented scenery floats around me.
units.displayText: I return to the garden, still in a daze. The fragmented scenery floats around me.

spans.text: I return to the garden, still in a daze. The fragmented scenery floats around me.

units.rawText: The girl in white gazes at me and smiles.
units.displayText: The girl in white gazes at me and smiles.

spans.text: The girl in white gazes at me and smiles.

units.rawText: ...Hurry and wake up.
units.displayText: ...Hurry and wake up.

spans.text: ...Hurry and wake up.

units.rawText: I bolt upright into a sitting position.
units.displayText: I bolt upright into a sitting position.

spans.text: I bolt upright into a sitting position.

units.rawText: Looking around, I see that Antonina's devices are already offline. The other three are lying beside me, and their wounds have been bandaged.
units.displayText: Looking around, I see that Antonina's devices are already offline. The other three are lying beside me, and their wounds have been bandaged.

spans.text: Looking around, I see that Antonina's devices are already offline. The other three are lying beside me, and their wounds have been bandaged.

units.rawText: Before I can breathe a sigh of relief, a familiar mechanical noise reaches my ears.
units.displayText: Before I can breathe a sigh of relief, a familiar mechanical noise reaches my ears.

spans.text: Before I can breathe a sigh of relief, a familiar mechanical noise reaches my ears.

units.rawText: [Warning: Subject has regained consciousness.]
units.displayText: [Warning: Subject has regained consciousness.]

spans.text: [Warning: Subject has regained consciousness.]

units.rawText: Can you check the target's current neural cloud status?
units.displayText: Can you check the target's current neural cloud status?

spans.text: Can you check the target's current neural cloud status?

units.rawText: [Checking... Warning: Target is an Irregular Agent. Continue program Y/N?]
units.displayText: [Checking... Warning: Target is an Irregular Agent. Continue program Y/N?]

spans.text: [Checking... Warning: Target is an Irregular Agent. Continue program Y/N?]

units.rawText: Continue... No, wait, subdue them first.
units.displayText: Continue... No, wait, subdue them first.

spans.text: Continue... No, wait, subdue them first.

units.rawText: I hear a series of mechanical transforming noises, followed immediately by the sight of countless glowing gun barrels before me.
units.displayText: I hear a series of mechanical transforming noises, followed immediately by the sight of countless glowing gun barrels before me.

spans.text: I hear a series of mechanical transforming noises, followed immediately by the sight of countless glowing gun barrels before me.

units.rawText: [Preparing to commence armed suppression.]
units.displayText: [Preparing to commence armed suppression.]

spans.text: [Preparing to commence armed suppression.]

60.name: Pierides Sector
60.description: A private sector that belongs to an artist. It is used for storing artworks digitally.
